verdict.rationale: Asana explicitly documents a 'developer sandbox' as a temporary Asana domain with limited users for testing purposes (asana-docs-17), plus a deprecation-testing mechanism via Asana-Enable/Disable headers to safely trial API behavior changes without risking production apps (asana-docs-19, asana-docs-23, asana-supp-deprecations). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox setup experience and no explicit mention of how AI agent testing specifically uses the sandbox.
